found.model: password-protected document storage, not report generation

gap: No dedicated app for P601-qualified LEV inspectors generating HSG258-format TExT reports. Third-party deliverable: employer keeps cert, must show to HSE on request. Penalty: COSHH breach, HSE enforcement, unlimited fine.
